policy.canonical_owner_rule: One primary query has one registered canonical owner and one canonical route.
policy.completion_rule: A record can become complete only after its completion profile has all required release evidence.
policy.publication_rule: This ledger records work and evidence. It does not authorize publication by itself.

release_waves.name: Urgent legal, entry and expired date corrections
release_waves.exit_gate: Every changed public route passes content, canonical, breadcrumb, link, schema, indexability and mobile checks.

release_waves.name: Missing parent hubs
release_waves.exit_gate: Each hub has a distinct query owner, useful body content and crawlable links to its live or planned children.

release_waves.name: Core pillars, destinations and live legacy pages
release_waves.exit_gate: Tourism, business, Bangkok, Phuket, Koh Samui, hotels, relocation and their live spokes meet the release evidence contract.

release_waves.name: Draft extraction, rewriting and consolidation
release_waves.exit_gate: Every draft has an extraction, integration or discard receipt and no raw duplicate draft is published.

release_waves.name: Map, service directory, shop and property project database
release_waves.exit_gate: Structured entities, filters, prices and transaction paths have source, freshness and user acceptance evidence.

release_waves.name: Sitewide SEO and migration acceptance
release_waves.exit_gate: All protected routes, redirects, canonicals, breadcrumbs, internal links, schema, sitemaps and mobile views pass final acceptance.
